lines.text: Many learners say: He is more taller than me.
Better: He is taller than me.
Older! She is older than her brother.

data.wrong: He is more taller than me.

native.tip: 短形容词比较级直接加 -er，前面不要再加 more。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He is more taller than me.”？😅 短形容词加 -er 就够了，不用再加 more：“He is taller than me.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“taller”。短词加 -er 不加 more！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Short adjectives take er, so do not add more.
en.caption: Do you say “He is more taller than me.”? 😅 Short adjectives only need er, not more as well: “He is taller than me.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
